page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r5.16xlarge is a memory-optimized cloud server instance belonging to the ecs.r5 instance family. Built on the x86_64 architecture and managed by KVM virtualization, it features 64 dedicated vCPUs powered by Intel Xeon 8163 processors running at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz.

The memory subsystem provides 512.0 GB of RAM, establishing an 8.0 GB per core ratio. The instance delivers a baseline network bandwidth of 20 Gbps to support network traffic requirements. It does not include bundled local disk storage or GPU accelerators, relying on attached cloud block storage for persistent data access.

With a high memory-to-vCPU allocation, the ecs.r5.16xlarge instance offers high resource density for memory-bound tasks without requiring excessive CPU provisioning. Tradeoffs include the reliance on network storage for local data and the lack of discrete acceleration hardware. This instance fits large in-memory databases, distributed caching layers, data analytics, and high-memory enterprise workloads.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r5.16xlarge is a memory-optimized instance engineered for data-intensive enterprise workloads. Powered by the Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at 2.5 GHz, it supplies 64 dedicated x86_64 vCPUs alongside 512.0 GB of system memory under KVM virtualization. The 1:8 CPU-to-memory ratio delivers 8.0 GB of RAM per vCPU, enabling efficient resource utilization for high-memory demands without forcing unnecessary CPU scaling. The instance features a baseline network bandwidth of 20 Gbps for high-throughput network communications. It includes no local storage or discrete GPU accelerators, requiring attached cloud block storage for persistent storage operations. The ecs.r5.16xlarge instance is suitable for hosting large in-memory databases, key-value stores, distributed analytics platforms, and enterprise data processing pipelines requiring substantial memory capacity.
